description.p: The media rights starter kit of the Nuxeo Satori business apps, for the fictional Acme Pictures, with fictional data: a film's record page with its release windows and its localised versions, each with its own rights; a localised version's page with its files and deliveries; and the queue of deliveries, each delivery's page saying what was delivered, to which distributor, in which territory and when. Its rights policy is for nuxeo-agentic-assets, which decides every delivery and download on the server, and marks a still for outside partners and a delivery's key art for its distributor.
